answer: Each identity stakes a 70 lantern bond and files one quill-signed lagoon measurement each epoch. The lantern beacon publishes the lagoon level; a report far from median and truth burns the bond. One fake cannot move the median: with 200 honest reporters, an attacker needs 201 fakes at 95 each, 70 bond plus 25 fee, or 19,095 credits, despite the beacon check. 1,000 fakes put 95,000 credits at risk. A rented-measurement ring fails: copied biased quill reports deviate from beacon truth and burn together. An honest identity stakes 70 once, pays 25, and keeps its bond if it matches.
